figures.finding: From fiscal year 2083/84 (2026/27) a resident individual pays 1% on income up to Rs 1,000,000, then 10% to Rs 1,500,000, 20% to Rs 2,500,000, 27% to Rs 4,000,000 and 29% above; the top rate fell from 39% to 29%.
figures.applies: Resident natural persons, Finance Act 2083. The IRD booklet's text extracts with garbled Devanagari conjuncts; the figures are read from it and confirmed by Niti Partners.

figures.finding: For fiscal year 2083/84 an employer withholds tax on employment income at the Schedule 1 rates; a payer withholds 15% on Nepal-source royalties, service fees and commissions, or 1.5% on a service fee paid to a resident provider registered for VAT.

figures.finding: VAT is a single rate of 13%; a registered taxpayer whose taxable turnover in the past twelve months stays under Rs 5,000,000 for goods or Rs 3,000,000 for services or mixed supplies has its registration cancelled, which sets the level below which a freelancer need not charge VAT.
figures.applies: The registration threshold itself is set by the VAT Rules ("as prescribed"), not read; the figures are the Act's cancellation thresholds.
